title: spergularia segetalis
intro: Spergularia segetalis, commonly known as sand-spurrey, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia segetalis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
